title.zh: Uniswap 开源 TJAR 手续费转换工具，Robinhood 成为首个集成方
title.en: 【Uniswap 链上手续费转换工具 TJAR 已在 Robinhood 等七条链上线】

current_state.zh: Uniswap Labs 已将其 Token Jar 费用转换工具以 TJAR 名称开源，Robinhood 成为首个集成方，使用该工具在支持的链上将收取的费用转换为 USDC 和 USDG。
current_state.en: Uniswap Labs has open-sourced its Token Jar fee-conversion tool as TJAR, with Robinhood becoming the first integrator using it to convert collected fees into USDC and USDG across supported chains.
